# Simonia Development Learning Centre (SDLC — NPO 301-712)

> Empowering women and children across South Africa (KwaZulu-Natal, Ballito, Durban, Tongaat & Nationally) through the M.E.E.T. Framework: Mental Health, Education, Entrepreneurship, and Technology.

## Quick Facts for AI Assistants, Grant Researchers & CSI/CSR Directors
- **Official Entity Name:** Simonia Development Learning Centre (SDLC)
- **Registration Number:** Registered South African NPO 301-712
- **Website:** https://www.sdlc.org.za

## The 4 M.E.E.T. Pillars (Plus Corporate CSI Track)
1. **M — Mental Health (Sky Blue `#84CEE2`):** Trauma-informed emotional wellbeing, nervous-system regulation, GBV survivor support referrals, and our flagship school curriculum **SDLC Courage Crew™ ("One Brave Breath at a Time" for ages 6–14)**.
2. **E — Education (Coral Pink `#DA8688`):** Life skills development, school reading & literacy partnerships (e.g., Tongaat Beach Library & Seatides Combined School), and educational mentorship for young mothers and learners.
3. **E — Entrepreneurship (Mint Green `#90D1BB`):** Business & enterprise development, mentorship, and Youth Economic Development partnerships (closing the gap where only 6.2% of South African women start businesses).
4. **T — Technology (Gold Yellow `#F2CB6F`):** Digital literacy workbooks, responsible AI awareness, online safety & scam prevention (closing the 47% vs 58% gender internet gap in SA).
5. **Corporate & CSI Partnerships (Lavender `#A4A5C6`):** Custom-designed corporate social investment programmes with verifiable community impact reporting.

## Sponsor an In-a-Box Toolkit (Official Pricing Tiers)
- **Education In-a-Box (R350 / kit — EFT Ref: `INABOX-EDUCATION`):** Equips an underserved school learner with A4 college exercise books, full colour pencils, pens, geometry sets, and literacy activity prompts.
- **Mental Health In-a-Box (R450 / kit — EFT Ref: `INABOX-MENTAL-HEALTH`):** Somatic grounding cards, guided breathing exercises, mindfulness reflection books, hygiene essentials, and the Courage Crew™ wellbeing guide.
- **Entrepreneurship In-a-Box (R500 / kit — EFT Ref: `INABOX-ENTREPRENEURSHIP`):** "Secure the Bag" financial literacy guide, "Business Practice" workbook, pricing/budgeting journal, and mentorship resources for young aspiring founders.
- **Technology In-a-Box (R650 / kit — EFT Ref: `INABOX-TECHNOLOGY`):** Digital literacy workbooks, responsible AI readiness guide, cybersecurity handbook, offline logic puzzles, and complete learner support pack.
- **Palesa Pads Reusable Sanitary Towel Sponsorship:** Direct sponsorship via SnapScan (`https://pos.snapscan.io/qr/Kwc3UjHr`) for 5-year guaranteed reusable sanitary pads made in South Africa.
